clips.title: The story
paras: In the Undercity, Master Apothecary Faranell prepares a base for a deadly Forsaken poison. Mudsnout Mixture begins with mushrooms sent north from Tarren Mill.

Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill seeks to craft a virulent new biological weapon. He sends a composite made from Mudsnout Blossoms north to the Undercity. The toxic mushrooms grow at Nethander Stead, held by gnolls. Master Apothecary Faranell sees promise in the composite and adds his own colloid of decay. The resulting Mudsnout Mixture is volatile. It steadies the mushroom compound and prepares its virulent properties for further catalytic refinement in the foothills.
